notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control have at least five distinct abilities from among those listed in Odric's ability.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Odric.
Odric enters the battlefield, creating at least five Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Blood tokens, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
